item.title: Myanmar's civil war: the situation
item.description:
The junta has expanded attacks across the border, bombing a health centre in Thailand's Tak province and striking Karen positions in Mae Hong Son, while blaming resistance groups for firing into Thailand. Resistance forces continue to target civilians, with reports of children killed in strikes and civilians under fire from the military. Dead Starlink terminals are being used to locate and kill people, and the junta faces criticism for operating without consequences. The United States is linking deeper diplomatic engagement with Myanmar to access its rare-earth resources, and Japan publicly denied seeking Myanmar’s removal from the FATF blacklist. 2,332 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

Machine-written from the linked sources, checked for figures and names not in them.
